C1.quote: we characterize prominent proportionality axioms as equilibria of budgeting games
C1.note: Main results equate proportionality axioms with equilibrium notions (EQ/AX). The finiteness of improvement dynamics and strong-equilibrium existence are EQ. Tree-Sweep is an algorithm computing equilibria (AL).
